headline: Microsoft Ramps Up Homegrown AI Chip Push
headline_vi: Microsoft làm tăng chip AI gia đình
summary: Microsoft is installing the latest version of its Maia chips in data centers to power its AI software using mostly homegrown hardware. The company expects to stock multiple gigawatts of its Maia chips, with the Maia 300 starting to roll out next year. Bloomberg's Matt Day joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloombe
